title: Mix Mex Max
description: Codeforces problem CF2127A - Mix Mex Max
expected_approach: After removing all -1 elements, check whether all remaining elements (if any) are equal and non-zero; if yes print YES, otherwise NO.

test_cases.explanation: We can set all elements to 1 → mex([1,1,1])=0, and max-min =1−1=0.
No -1’s to replace, and the condition fails at the last triple.
Even with replacements, the first triple fails: mex([5,5,1])=0 ≠ 5–1=4.
